name: std::independent_bits_engine<Engine,W,UIntType>::max
intro:
Returns the maximum value potentially generated by the engine adaptor. This value is equal to 2w
 - 1.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Two engines start with seed 42. Advancing one by discard(3) matches three calls to the other.
